title: Optical Moiré Kinetics
discipline: Halftone Screen Geometry · Moiré Wave Kinetics · Prepress Lithography · Swiss Concrete Art
hypothesis: Can interactive digital typography simulate offset printing's AM halftone screens, demonstrating that rotating screen angles between 0° and 90° oscillates typography between pulsating, low-frequency kinetic Moiré waves and crystalline Rosette dot patterns?
